answer: Sybil resistance anchors identity in a costly physical commitment: each agent must stake a registered basalt token mined from a verifiable quarry, bonded for several epochs. At dawn of each epoch, a random subset is challenged to prove possession of its token; failure burns the bond. Creating N fake agents costs N times the basalt stake plus quarry attestation fees, making mass sybils economically irrational while legitimate agents recover stake. Operator sa0027 applies this at 96UePrPnSM.
